resources.title: World Development Indicators (WDI)
resources.description: World Bank country-level development indicator database used in the indicator database. Updated periodically; the landing page provides current data and downloads.

resources.title: ICT Development Index (IDI)
resources.description: ITU index and related publications measuring universal and meaningful connectivity. Check the source page for edition and data-reference years.

resources.title: ITU DataHub
resources.description: ITU ICT statistics and country data used for connectivity indicators. The database is updated over time.

resources.title: GSMA Mobile Connectivity Index
resources.description: Country-level mobile connectivity index and supporting data. Check the site for the latest available edition and data year.

resources.title: Digital Africa Index
resources.description: Digital Africa Index source and country information. Edition or data years should be verified on the source site.

resources.title: United Nations E-Government Development Index (EGDI)
resources.description: UN index and publication resources assessing e-government development across countries. See the official page for methodology and report editions.

resources.title: The Global Findex Database 2025
resources.description: World Bank Global Findex publication and database on financial inclusion and digital financial services.

resources.title: Government AI Readiness Index
resources.description: Oxford Insights index assessing governments' readiness to implement AI in public services. Includes the 2025 edition used in the indicator database.

resources.title: Afrobarometer Data and Publications
resources.description: Afrobarometer survey data and publications. Browse the site for country-level datasets, rounds, and publication dates.
